newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi meets opposition leader Berlusconi.
newsitem.headline: Prodi meets opposition leader Berlusconi.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi held talks on Friday morning with opposition leader Silvio Berlusconi, Prodi's office said in a statement.
The statement did not say what the two men discussed.
In recent weeks Berlusconi, leader of the centre-right Freedom Alliance, has expressed a willingness to support government attempts to bring forward the 1998 budget if certain conditions are met.
